newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice closes firm on light movement, cash.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice closes firm on light movement, cash.

text.p: CBOT rice futures closed higher on slow producer selling and on a firm undertone in the cash market, traders said.
"There is a lack of adequate supply coming to market," a trader said. But he said the U.S. export sales pace remains slow which limited gains.
Rice futures volume was estimated at 300 contracts, down from 453 Tuesday, according to the CBOT. Rice options volume was estimated at zero, down from 50 Tuesday.
Rice closed unchanged to two cents per cwt higher, with November up two at $9.89.
